architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions: SVC-001 owns CashDepositTransaction (ENT-077) and generates the AML threshold report reference.
SVC-001 publishes EVT-166 CashDepositAboveThreshold for amounts exceeding £10,000. SVC-015 (CAP-005) consumes this for MLRO review.

consumed_events.name: CashDepositAboveThreshold
consumed_events.purpose: Queue AML cash threshold report for MLRO review. Trigger suspicious activity assessment if patterns detected.

consumed_events.name: CashDepositAboveThreshold
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable AML threshold breach record

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-001 (CAP-001) → EVT-166 → SVC-015 (CAP-005): AML threshold notification for MLRO review
SVC-001 (CAP-001) → EVT-166 → SVC-103 (CAP-008): Immutable threshold record
